summary: Iteration 58 — Verified the deterministic template fallback for roster workout generation when the LLM (Claude via Emergent Universal Key) is unavailable (budget exceeded / timeout / provider error). 27/28 tests pass. Unit + shape tests for feature_workout_fallback all green: build_template_plan / is_empty_or_llm_failure export correctly; is_empty_or_llm_failure([]) → True and is_empty_or_llm_failure([{exercises:[{name:'x'}]}]) → False; a 14-day stub roster mixing home/layover/night_flight/long_haul_flight/overnight_flight/standby/reserve/simulator/rest/off/annual_leave produces exactly the expected titles ('Full Body Strength', 'Hotel / Bodyweight Session', 'Flight Recovery Mobility', 'Standby Activation', 'Light Activation'), each with 5 exercises and a non-empty rationale; explicit rest/off/annual_leave days are omitted; hotel_gyms='rare' switches home-day title to 'Full Body Bodyweight' and 'always' to 'Full Body Hotel Gym'. Static wiring of server.py confirmed: fallback import appears in BOTH the initial roster worker AND the retry worker; 'used_template = False' appears in both blocks; the exact completion message 'Starter plan ready — Louis will refine your sessions soon.' is present; used_template=used_template is passed into _set_job. End-to-end persistence test (pymongo, no LLM call) confirms workouts written by the main worker's persist block carry source='template' and needs_coach_review=true when used_template is True, and rest days are correctly skipped. Iter56 regression is green: /api/roster/jobs/active still surfaces needs_review jobs; /roster/jobs/{id}/acknowledge hides them and returns 404 on unknown id. ONE REAL BUG FOUND — the _retry_worker persist block (server.py ~lines 2694-2714) does NOT stamp source='template' or needs_coach_review=true on the workouts it writes; only the main worker (line 2480-2481) does. Job-level used_template flag + completion message are correct in the retry worker, but the DB rows written by a retry that hits fallback are indistinguishable from LLM-generated ones — Louis has no per-workout signal to upgrade them. NO real roster upload triggered (per agent_to_agent_context_note; LLM budget is exceeded).

critical.issue: server.py _retry_worker persist block (lines 2694-2714) is missing the `source: 'template' if used_template else 'coaching_system'` and `needs_coach_review: bool(used_template)` fields on the doc it writes. When the LLM is still unavailable on retry and the template fallback fires, the persisted workouts DO NOT include source='template' or needs_coach_review=true — breaking the requirement 'When roster upload fallback fires, resulting workouts DB rows must include source=template and needs_coach_review=true'. The main worker at line 2480-2481 sets these correctly; the retry path forgot them. Fix: add the two keys to the retry worker's `doc` dict, mirroring server.py:2480-2481.

action_items: server.py _retry_worker (~line 2694-2714): add "source": "template" if used_template else "coaching_system" and "needs_coach_review": bool(used_template) to the doc dict — mirror lines 2480-2481 of the main worker. Without this, template workouts written on retry will look identical to LLM-generated ones and coach filters/dashboards that key off source or needs_coach_review will miss them.
critical_code_review_comments: feature_workout_fallback.py is well-scoped and deterministic — no I/O, no LLM calls, pure functions. Templates are safe (5 exercises each), rationale strings are plain English, RPE/rest values are reasonable. Good.

server.py:2435-2456 main worker fallback flow is correct: wait_for → TimeoutError/Exception → workouts=[] → is_empty_or_llm_failure(workouts) → build_template_plan → used_template=True; heartbeat cancelled in finally.

server.py:2480-2481 stamps `source: template|coaching_system` + `needs_coach_review: bool(used_template)` — this is the ONE place the two flags are set in the whole codebase. The retry worker (2694-2714) omits both, which is the HIGH bug above.
server.py:2524-2531 opens a coach task when used_template=true so Louis is notified — good. Same logic mirrored in retry worker at 2737-2744 — good.
server.py:2541-2544 and 2745-2748: completion_message correctly conditional on used_template — 'Starter plan ready — Louis will refine your sessions soon.' matches the spec exactly.
server.py:2550 and 2753: used_template=used_template is set on the job in BOTH workers — clients can inspect the flag via /api/roster/jobs/{id}. Good.
Minor: retry worker's persist doc also drops seconds fields the main worker sets — but only `source` and `needs_coach_review` are functional gaps; the rest are duplicated correctly.

rca_of_issue: RCA for the failing test: the main worker's persist block at server.py:2466-2488 correctly writes source and needs_coach_review, but when the retry worker was added (server.py:2685-2714) the doc dict was copy-pasted WITHOUT those two lines. Both blocks share the same shape otherwise. Reproduction: (1) trigger a roster upload that produces 0 workouts (LLM budget exceeded), (2) client sees needs_review job, (3) client POSTs /api/roster/jobs/{id}/retry, (4) LLM still fails, (5) template fallback runs and persists workouts, (6) DB shows workouts with NO source and NO needs_coach_review fields. Mitigation is a two-line addition to the retry worker's doc dict.
